name: ASN
description:
ASN information describing the Autonomous System responsible for routing
the queried IP address or the specified ASN. Costs 1 credit.

as_number.description: Complete Autonomous System Number that was looked up.

organization.description: Name of the organization to which the ASN is assigned.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code where the ASN is registered.

type.description:
ASN category. Possible values include `ISP`, `HOSTING`, `BUSINESS`,
`EDUCATION`, or `GOVERNMENT` when available.

date_allocated.description: Date when the ASN was originally allocated.

rir.description:
Regional Internet Registry that allocated the ASN.
Examples include `RIPE`, `ARIN`, `APNIC`, `LACNIC`, `AFRINIC`, etc.

allocation_status.description: Current allocation status of the ASN.

num_of_ipv4_routes.description: Number of IPv4 prefixes announced by this ASN.

num_of_ipv6_routes.description: Number of IPv6 prefixes announced by this ASN.

items.description:
Represents a connected Autonomous System such as a peer,
upstream provider, or downstream customer.

as_number.description: Autonomous System Number of the connected network.

description.description: Name or description of the connected network operator.

country.description: Country code of the connected ASN.

downstreams.description: Downstream (customer) ASNs connected to this ASN.
